questions.sentence: By the time the board of directors convened next Tuesday morning, the restructuring committee will have completed its review of the balance sheets, assuming that the external auditors furnish the missing valuations on schedule. <No error>
tokens: its review of the balance sheets,
questions.explanation: [Topic: Future Time Clause] -> The adverbial phrase "By the time" introduces a future time clause. In English, future time clauses cannot use a future modal or a past tense to denote an upcoming event; they require the Present Simple tense to anchor the future sequence. | [Topic: Klausa Masa Depan] Frasa keterangan "By the time" mengawali klausa waktu masa depan. Dalam bahasa Inggris, klausa waktu masa depan tidak dapat menggunakan modal bentuk masa depan ataupun bentuk lampau untuk menyatakan peristiwa yang akan datang; klausa tersebut memerlukan bentuk *Present Simple* (masa kini sederhana) sebagai landasan bagi rangkaian peristiwa di masa depan.
